rationale: David and Lisa are both deeply embedded in robotics and industrial automation, with David bringing a decade of production experience shipping autonomous systems (drones, tractors) and now building real-time infrastructure at LiveKit, while Lisa consults on AI and robotics integration for industrial clients through her stealth startup and RL Smart Solutions. David's conviction that production robotics requires purpose-built real-time observability infrastructure aligns directly with Lisa's focus on delivering bespoke robotics and digital twin solutions to automotive manufacturers and industrial enterprises—they could explore how LiveKit's real-time capabilities power the observability layer for the consulting and automation projects Lisa is delivering.
intro_message: David Chen, meet Lisa Wang — you're both builders at the intersection of robotics and industrial automation, and David's real-time infrastructure work at LiveKit could be foundational for the production systems and digital twin solutions Lisa is deploying with her enterprise clients.
